prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Draw a production sprite sheet for the Demian game with exactly 16 independent, alpha-transparent full-body frames in a square 4×4 grid. Image 1 is the identity and costume reference; identify the character from the front/three-quarter figures on its board. Image 2 is Arsal, use only its 16 slots as pose, foot axis, width of outline, camera angle, chibi body proportions and timing reference. Redraw each pose with the character from image 1. TAHER DB. Preserve his distinct dense short black curls, strong eyebrows, warm olive complexion, faint jaw stubble, softly smiling wide cheeks, slate-blue short-sleeved button-up shirt with a visible center button placket and muted seams, charcoal pleated trousers and black lace-up sneakers with bright cream soles. Natural bare forearms. No tie, no watch, no props. Crisp pixel-chibi painted clusters and deep one-pixel-like outline matching Arsal, warm lit face and no photo-realistic rendering. Match the guide's front three-quarter camera towards screen-right, head/hair about 40–43% of upright body height, clean silhouette at 64px. Same eyes, hair texture, outfit, limb lengths, shoe profile, and moderately broad shoulders in all cels. Use four equally spaced columns and rows with ≥20px alpha gutter between poses, each pose centered and complete, all lowest soles on consistent implied ground lines. Exact row-major order. Rows 1–2 are eight frames of ONE walk cycle, at moderate stride. Row 1 has nearer foot leading, row 2 has farther foot leading. In each row: heel strikes ahead with opposite shoulder advancing; weight settles onto the forward sole and back heel lifts; knees pass under hips with back foot slightly elevated; toes roll off while the opposite leg reaches for the next contact. Walking arms swing in opposition, elbows mildly bent and hands low. Retain Arsal's foot cycle, with clear grounded contact at ALL walk poses. Rows 3–4 are eight frames of ONE running cycle, with a visibly larger thigh separation, modest forward lean, bent elbows and forward/back arm drive. One row for each leading leg. Four poses per half-cycle: extended stride; compressed single-leg contact; trailing foot rises with knees passing; both legs in brief flight, knees opening toward next extension. One person facing screen right throughout, same head volume and clothing, no camera rotation, no duplicated silhouette per cycle. True transparent background around each sprite, no labels, no staging, no checkerboard, no shadows, no characters from the Arsal identity, no boxes, text, visual effects, stray dust, colored glows, frames, or overlays, no clipped shoes or hands.
